field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: Texas uses single-sales factor for apportionment (sourcing receipts to Texas)

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: Texas economic nexus: $500,000 in Texas receipts (NOT the federal $100K standard)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: Texas has NO corporate income tax (franchise tax is calculated separately)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: Texas does not use transaction count threshold

field.name: apportioned_margin
field.comment: Margin apportioned to Texas based on receipts

field.name: cogs
field.comment: Texas COGS for margin tax calculation (optional deduction method)

field.name: compensation
field.comment: Texas compensation (wages and benefits) for margin tax calculation (optional deduction method)

field.name: deduction_method
field.comment: Method used to calculate margin: cogs, compensation, or 70_percent (taxpayer selects most beneficial)

field.name: ez_computation_rate
field.comment: E-Z computation rate (0.575% of revenue over $1.23M threshold)

field.name: franchise_tax
field.comment: Texas franchise tax liability (NOT an income tax)

field.name: is_retail_wholesale
field.comment: Business primarily engaged in retail or wholesale (qualifies for 0.375% rate)

field.name: margin_deduction
field.comment: Amount deducted from revenue based on selected method

field.name: margin_tax_rate
field.comment: TX franchise tax rate on taxable margin (0.75% for most businesses, 0.375% for retail/wholesale)

field.name: no_tax_due_threshold
field.comment: Texas no tax due threshold ($1.23M in revenue for 2025)

field.name: qualifies_for_ez_computation
field.comment: Qualifies for Texas E-Z computation ($20M revenue or less)

field.name: qualifies_for_no_tax_due
field.comment: Total revenue below $1.23M threshold - no franchise tax due

field.name: taxable_margin
field.comment: Taxable margin after deduction (revenue minus COGS or compensation)

field.name: total_revenue
field.comment: Total revenue for Texas franchise tax (gross receipts from all sources)
